answer: What keeps this honest is grader accuracy tracked against canary answers, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. Cloning 429 keys multiplies the price 429-fold: 51051 POA locked, or 7722 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. One lagoon of signal, one oasis of cost, one orchard of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
